card.name: Decimal point inside numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point (or a digit next to it) inside a decimal number, right after the whole-number part, as in 49.5, 3.214 or $12.08. It is strongest in coordinates and in math comparisons of decimals.

modes.label: Coordinates
modes.description: Decimal point or digit in latitude/longitude values.

modes.label: Decimal comparisons
modes.description: Decimal point in numbers being ordered or compared in math exercises.
modes.example: Put the following in order from greatest to least: 3.3, 3.9, 3<<.>>214, 3.0

modes.label: Money and measurements
modes.description: Decimal point in prices, section numbers or sizes.

card.plain: It marks the decimal point inside a number, mostly in coordinates and math problems.
